title: Best Dress Up Game Apps for Styling Your Own Character (2026)
summary: The best dress up game apps where you style your own original character, for iPhone and Android, with verified prices, ads and in-app purchase labels.
body_markdown:
Outfits are one of the fastest ways to show who a character is. These dress up game apps let you style **your own** character, not just a pre-made one.


*Redbean is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any of the apps or companies named here. App names are trademarks of their owners. No official artwork is used on this page.*


Store details checked on the US App Store and Google Play on October 24, 2026. Prices and labels can change, so check the listing before you download.


Table of Contents


Toggle


##


Best dress up game apps for your own character


#


###


1. Everskies: avatar dress-up plus community


#


The listing describes an avatar maker and life sim where you create your own character and match clothes, hairstyles and shoes. **Developer:** PocketzWorld / Pocket Worlds. **Price:** Free on iOS and Google Play; Google Play lists ads and in-app purchases. App Store rating: 12+.


###


2. Gacha Life 2: outfits plus scenes


#


Thousands of dresses, shirts and hairstyles for characters you design, then a Studio for scenes. **Developer:** Lunime. **Price:** Free on iOS and Google Play; Google Play lists ads.


###


3. Gacha Club: free customization


#


The listing says customization has no in-app purchases. **Developer:** Lunime. **Price:** Free on iOS and Google Play; Google Play lists ads; the listing says customization has no in-app purchases.


###


4. Pocket Love!: style a couple


#


Customize a couple’s look in detail, then decorate their home. **Developer:** HyperBeard. **Price:** Free on iOS and Google Play; Google Play lists ads and in-app purchases.


###


5. ZEPETO: 3D avatar fashion


#


**Developer:** NAVER Z. **Price:** Free on iOS and Google Play; Google Play lists ads and in-app purchases.


###


6. Covet Fashion: styling challenges


#


Dress up a model and build a digital closet. The App Store listing notes optional purchases that include random items. **Developer:** Crowdstar. **Price:** Free on iOS and Google Play; Google Play lists ads and in-app purchases.
**Note:** you style a model rather than build a character, so treat it as styling practice.


###


7. Avatar World and Toca Boca World: younger players


#


Both are rated 4+ on the App Store and include outfit styling for characters. **Developer:** Pazu Games. **Price:** Free on iOS and Google Play; Google Play lists in-app purchases. Toca Boca World: Free on iOS and Google Play; Google Play lists in-app purchases.


###


8. Redbean: let the outfit meet the world


#


Redbean is free to download. Its App Store listing describes it as a place where your original characters live in a town together, build relationships, visit places, react to events and create stories.

##


Style tips that build character


#


- **Dress for the backstory.** A worn jacket says more than a new one.
- **Keep one constant item** across every outfit.
- **Match the palette** to the personality.


More on designing from scratch:[make your own character](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/make-your-own-character/) .


##


FAQ


#


**What’s the best dress up game app?** Everskies if styling your own avatar is the point. Gacha Life 2 if you want outfits and stories.


**Are dress up game apps free?** All the apps here are free to download, and most list ads or in-app purchases on Google Play.
